description:
Configure a custom product architecture for selling services. You must:

1. Create a new Order Item Type named 'Service' (machine name: service).
2. Add a required Text (plain) field named 'Device Serial Number' (machine name: field_device_serial_number) to this new Order Item Type.
3. Configure the 'Add to Cart' form display for this Order Item Type to ensure the Serial Number field is visible.
4. Create a new Product Type named 'Service' (machine name: service) and configure it to use your new 'Service' Order Item Type.
5. Create a product named 'iPhone Screen Repair' (SKU: SVC-IPHONE-SCREEN, Price: $89.99) using this new Product Type.

The goal is to have the Serial Number field appear on the Add to Cart form for this service product.
